metric_definitions.interval_recall: Fraction of annotated intervals containing at least one candidate representative; interval boundaries are inclusive.
metric_definitions.tolerant_interval_recall_5s: Interval recall after expanding each annotation by configured_tolerance_seconds (5 seconds by evaluation default) and clamping to movie bounds.
metric_definitions.candidate_sample_rate: Candidate representative samples divided by all representative samples.
metric_definitions.frame_candidate_precision: Candidate representatives inside the union of exact ground-truth intervals divided by all candidate representatives; this is frame-level precision only.
metric_definitions.estimated_vlm_workload: Evaluation-only union of candidate timestamp windows after configured context padding and merge-gap handling; it is not actual VLM cost.
